choices.SF-AD1/SF-TD1: Move only generated notice from the source secPr-owning frame anchor next-neighbor into first owned frame paragraph; keep source secPr/PAGE anchor. Declared body own paragraphs become regular bold=false/LEFT, headings remain explicitly bold.
choices.SF-AD3: Rebalance only actual six-column feature register; short rows use TABLE atomic pagination and repeated header. Narrow remarks use F key, full requirement/meeting/review/source/notes in page-width detail. Every detail paragraph carries F owner context and title keeps only next field.
choices.SF-TD2: Every installation-plan paragraph carries its I key, with first line I key + unchanged item ID/name. Full field input/type and own XML mapping preserved. Notice moves from after original source frame into its first paragraph.
choices.SF-TD4: Move only generated notice into first program description. The same source card becomes first paragraph of its dedicated body section, so section start replaces its redundant paragraph pageBreak; PAGE=1 ownership and all card controls/objects remain.
choices.captions: AD1/TD1/TD2/TD4 actual renderer captions use LEFT + Latin KEEP_WORD to prevent avoidable A-key splits; font height/image bytes and geometry profiles unchanged.

raster_metadata: Use separately explicit Hancom Mac12.30 PNG metadata profile via CLI when requested; do not change display geometry or originals. BMP source bytes remain source-hash-bound and are losslessly converted for embedding.
